page.layout: Running head across the top, with the page number at the right. One block of text in one column, set in italic, with a centred heading "FINIS LIBRI I." below it. At the foot: a signature at the left and a catchword at the right.

p.i: pellet ad honesta omnia, & ab inhonestis revocabit potentiss. Simul expendat Deum unum hoc, in omnibus, quæ suis unquam præcepit, sive de moribus civilibus, sive de cerimoniis præceperit, requisivisse, ut ipsum timeremus & amaremus, totoque ab ipso penderemus, tum cum proximis viveremus summa cum honestate, & officiosa dilectione. Hæc aperte satis omnia scriptura docent, cumque omnia non nisi per Christum nobis possint contingere, illum quoque omnes scriptura prædicant. Si typicos prateres intellectus voles adhibere, vide, quod sæpius jam monui, & diligenter adeo agnoscis observatum ab Apostolis, ut probe constet, & pateat similitudo, atque proportio inter typos illos, & Christum, vel Ecclesiam. Ad quod opus est te ante, ex Evangelicis literis, adeoque & spiritu Christi tenere, quid Christo, quid Ecclesiæ, tribuas. Nam si ex typos voles colligere, quod CHRISTO, & corpori ejus tribuas, idque Apostolicæ literæ non docent, neque ipse spiritus certo sanctius revelavit, nihil sane docebis & audies illud vulgatum, figura nihil probat. Hæc sane omnia copiosius, & pluribus exemplis fuissent explicanda, adeo pauci ad hoc id volunt observare, ut certa doceant, licentiaque allegoriarum, quas vocant, minime paucos & hodie nugatores reddit, ex solidis Ecclesiæ doctoribus, sed hæc integrum tractatum desiderant.

page.notes: The page number 173 is partly smudged and the last digit is uncertain. Several words in the italic paragraph are faint or broken by stains, notably "prateres", "sanctius" and "probat", and may be misread. The catchword "SIXTI-" is at the lower right and the signature "Y 3" at the lower left. Stains and a Google digitisation watermark at the bottom right are left out.
